title: Slow English podcast for A1 Beginners! 🦻Do you like the big cities?

segments.text: Hello and welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
segments.ipa: /həˈloʊ ənd ˈwɛlkəm bæk tu maɪ sloʊ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈpɔdˌkæst/

segments.text: This week I went to Mexico City.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs wik aɪ wɛnt tu ˈmɛksəˌkoʊ ˈsɪti/

segments.text: I went I love going to big cities.
segments.ipa: /aɪ wɛnt aɪ lʌv ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu bɪɡ ˈsɪtiz/

segments.text: I love trying all the best restaurants in the city.
segments.ipa: /aɪ lʌv ˈtraɪɪŋ ɔl ðə bɛst ˈrɛstərˌɑnts ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/

segments.text: I love just walking around and exploring.
segments.ipa: /aɪ lʌv dʒʌst ˈwɔkɪŋ ərˈaʊnd ənd ɪkˈsplɔrɪŋ/

segments.text: Do you like visiting big cities?
What do you like about big cities?
segments.ipa: /wʌt du ju laɪk əˈbaʊt bɪɡ ˈsɪtiz/

segments.text: Today I will relax at my Airbnb.
segments.ipa: /təˈdeɪ aɪ wɪl rɪˈlæks æt maɪ Airbnb/

segments.text: I plan on watching movies, eating food, and resting.
segments.ipa: /aɪ plæn ɑn ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ˈmuviz ˈitɪŋ fud ənd ˈrɛstɪŋ/

segments.text: Follow for more slow English podcasts.
